[Pedagogy audit v2 · New question to decide] For the type count gap (negative-factor). Comparison score 26, between p16-q16-block and p15-q11-block: The student takes out a negative HCF, which means choosing the sign and tracking the sign change inside the brackets. Parts c and d add an algebraic factor (m, b). This is slightly more than the plain multi-term HCF in p16-q16, but it has no context, unlike p15-q11.
Proposed question: Factorise these expressions by taking out a negative common factor.
a) $-6x-9$
b) $-8y+12$
c) $-15m^2-10m$
d) $-12ab+18b$
Answers: a) $-3(2x+3)$; b) $-4(2y-3)$; c) $-5m(3m+2)$; d) $-6b(2a-3)$
